CVE-2026-110658.title: Sofia-SIP through 1.13.18 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vuln ...
CVE-2026-110658.description: Sofia-SIP through 1.13.18 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in msg_multipart_parse() that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to crash the process by sending oversized MIME boundaries. Attackers can send an INVITE with a multipart Content-Type whose boundary exceeds the body length, causing memcmp to read past the heap buffer and crash the process.
